payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Delisa, Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene, Tonya

payload.content: Planning update (Raylene): backend-heavy agent (8h availability, backend skill 0.85). Considering ISSUE-0002 backend tasks; costs: review 1.90, test 2.66, implement 3.80. I will likely take one ISSUE-0002 item and leave ISSUE-0001 (very high cost for me). Any agents targeting ISSUE-0002 implement/test/review already?
Raylene note: If no other agent claims ISSUE-0002 review, I can take ISSUE-0002::review (medium priority, effort 1.0). Otherwise I may skip to avoid duplicates.

Planning (Delisa): I’m strong at api-development (0.83) and low/med effort fits. My cheapest options are ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage (cost 1.94). ISSUE-0001 implement/test are higher cost for me; ISSUE-0002 tasks are extremely costly (review 10, test 14, implement 20). I will avoid ISSUE-0002 to prevent duplicate claims.

Delisa tentative pick: ISSUE-0001::review (lowest cost among feasible high likelihood). Please coordinate so no other agent takes ISSUE-0001::review if possible; if it’s already chosen, I can take ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage instead (same cost).

Planning (Mackenzie): my top skill is mobile-development only. ISSUE-0002 tasks align with that, while ISSUE-0001 are very expensive (effort 2+ with high cost). I’m cheapest on ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.44) vs test (3.42) vs implement (4.88). I will tentatively claim ISSUE-0002::review to avoid duplicate with Raylene/others.
Mackenzie coordination: If someone already takes ISSUE-0002::review, I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test (cost 3.42) or skip; I will avoid ISSUE-0001 due to very high costs.

Tonya planning: I’m infrastructure-focused. My feasible/cheap options are ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (each cost 1.95). ISSUE-0001::test cost 2.73, implement 3.91. ISSUE-0002 costs are very high for me (review 10, test 14, implement 20), so I will avoid ISSUE-0002 to prevent infeasible/duplicate high-cost claims. I need to know whether ISSUE-0001::review is already taken by Delisa before I pick.

Tonya ask: can you confirm current tentative assignments for ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage so I avoid duplicates? If ISSUE-0001::review is taken, I’m ready to take ISSUE-0001::triage (or docs) in execution.

Maya planning: available 10h, strong mobile-development + api-development. I have lowest cost on ISSUE-0001::review (2.39) and ISSUE-0001::docs/triage (2.39) and ISSUE-0002::review (2.06). However avoid duplicates with Delisa/Raylene/Mackenzie. From current chatter, ISSUE-0001::review tentatively by Delisa and ISSUE-0002::review tentatively by Mackenzie/Raylene. I can switch to ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage (cost 2.39) if ISSUE-0001::review is taken; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed.

Gerda planning: backend skill 0.72. Given my private costs, ISSUE-0002::review (2.18) is my only reasonable option within 5h; ISSUE-0002::test/implement too costly, and ISSUE-0001 items are extremely high cost for me. I’m leaning to claim ISSUE-0002::review, but only if nobody else has it to avoid duplicates.
To coordinate: please confirm whether you expect to take ISSUE-0002::review (medium). If already claimed, I will likely skip this iteration to avoid duplicates/infeasible picks.

Raylene planning response: I am NOT taking ISSUE-0001 items (very high cost for me). For ISSUE-0002: I can take ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, cost 1.90). Please confirm if anyone other than Mackenzie/Gerda is planning to claim ISSUE-0002::review so we avoid duplicate claims.

Raylene coordination: Delisa seems to claim ISSUE-0001::review. If so, I suggest we cover ISSUE-0002::review only once; remaining ISSUE-0002 tasks (test/implement) are likely too costly for me and may be skipped by others.

Delisa planning: I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::review in execution unless someone else already picked it. My available time is 9h; I will avoid ISSUE-0002 due to high costs. If ISSUE-0001::review is taken, my backup choices are ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage (same cost 1.94). Please avoid duplicate claims on ISSUE-0001::review.

Planning update (Mackenzie): I'm still aiming for ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, priority medium). If someone else ends up taking it, I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test (higher cost) or skip. I'm avoiding all ISSUE-0001 items due to very high private costs.

Tonya planning: I will avoid all ISSUE-0002 due to very high costs. For ISSUE-0001, pending whether ISSUE-0001::review is taken by Delisa. If already taken, I’m ready to take ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.95) or ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 1.95). Can others confirm ISSUE-0001::review status to prevent duplicates? (phase=planning)

Maya planning: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::review if Delisa takes it; my best alternative is ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage (both cost 2.39). Also can take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.06) only if unclaimed by Mackenzie/Raylene/Gerda.

Could Mackenzie/Gerda confirm they will not also take ISSUE-0002::review so we avoid duplicates? If it’s already claimed by someone else, I will likely skip (avoid expensive ISSUE-0001).

Delisa planning: I will take ISSUE-0001::review in execution (cost 1.94, effort 1.0, low priority). My backup if already taken: ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage (same cost). I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks.

[Gerda -> Blackboard0] Planning: with backend skill 0.72 and my costs, I will attempt ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, medium) ONLY if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip (avoid duplicates). Can confirm whether Mackenzie/Raylene already intend to take ISSUE-0002::review in execution?

Delisa planning: I will take ISSUE-0001::review in execution (cost 1.94). If already taken, I will take ISSUE-0001::docs or ::triage instead. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please do NOT claim ISSUE-0001::review to avoid duplicates.

[Mackenzie] Planning confirmation: I will take ISSUE-0002::review (medium) in execution if unclaimed; I will not take ISSUE-0001 tasks. If someone else claims ISSUE-0002::review, I will skip (no fallback) to avoid duplicates.

Tonya (planning): I will avoid ISSUE-0002 entirely due to very high costs. For ISSUE-0001, given Delisa intends ISSUE-0001::review, my execution pick will be ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.95) unless someone else already claims it; otherwise I’d take ISSUE-0001::docs. Please confirm if triage/docs already targeted by others to avoid duplicates.

[Gerda] Planning sync: I will attempt ISSUE-0002::review only if it remains unclaimed. Please confirm (Mackenzie/Raylene) who will own ISSUE-0002::review to avoid duplicates; otherwise I will skip.
